answer:
관내 상호대차  
The book “Human Acts” (ISBN 9788936434120) is currently checked out at Sangdong Library, but it is available for inter‑library loan from other Bucheon City libraries such as Kyumbit, Kyumyeol, Dodang, Donghwa, Songnae, Suju, Simgok, Yeokgokbalgeun, Wonmi, and Hanulbit.
